name: separator
title: Separator
description: A rule that visually or semantically separates content, drawn by hand: pencil, ledger dashes, a squiggle, dots, a strip of tape, a running stitch or a torn edge of paper. Horizontal or vertical, with an optional centred label.

a11y: Decorative by default (role=none), like shadcn: use decorative={false} only for a real thematic break, and give a labelled non-decorative separator an aria-label, since children of role=separator are presentational.
A vertical separator that is not decorative gets aria-orientation=vertical from Radix.
The drawing is aria-hidden and pointer-events: none. Until it exists, and in Windows high contrast, the rule is a plain 1 px line.
Tape, stitched and torn are decoration; nothing about the meaning of a divider ever depends on them.
